text.text_excerpt: Bub's is a great local, casual hamburger spot in Midcity. I had been to their food truck once before they opened their brick & mortar location. They specialize in super thin smashed burgers made on a flattop grill. I got the Royale- two patties, onion, lettuce, tomato, American cheese, pickles, and signature Bub sauce. It super flavorful and excellent. The patties are very thin, so I highly recommend getting at least two if you want a more filling meal. The fries are also good. They are big enough to share between 2 people. It is an order at the counter restaurant. They have indoor seating, but most people were sitting outside or at the bar next door. Great burger! Best one I've ever eaten? No, but still very good. I went with the Royale, which I believe was the right choice... two perfect patties, cheese, plenty of red onions and special sauce. Loved it, although the bun could have been a bit larger to better accommodate the patties, which extended a good inch or so beyond the bun. $9.50 seems a bit high for what it was, IMO. My wife had the Microdose (single burger), and wasn't impressed, due to very few grilled onions and thin patty. We both enjoyed the fries and the perfectly seasoned brussels sprouts. I've been chomping these burgers for a good while now. I looked forward to any pop up they would have anywhere near me. Well as luck would have it they popped up permanently in my neighborhood. My go to is the bub royale. It's juicy, got the crunch of red onion, and soft brioche bun. And bonus it makes me laugh every time making me think about Pulp Fiction "What do they call it?" "Royale with cheese." Along with my royale I tried the degen fries. Don't recall this ever being an option at the pop up so had to give it a try. This was also very good.
